worked_example.answer: Make it specific: topic, reader and form of the answer.

cards.idea: A prompt is the question or instruction you give to an AI tool.
example: “Explain fractions with two examples” is a prompt.

cards.idea: A good prompt is clear and specific, gives context and says the form of the answer.
example: “In three simple sentences, for a Form 1 pupil, explain what a cell is.”

cards.idea: After the answer: read carefully, check facts, and ask a follow-up if needed. Never put personal details in a prompt.
example: “Can you give one more example?” is a follow-up.
